text:
maria: Heads up — brought up a new HF model (requires trust_remote_code). Things look fine in HF, but after our hf->redwood conversion + 4-bit quant the sentence-embedding quality collapses.
ash: ugh. any obvious errors in conversion logs?
maria: no stack traces. just embedding sims drop from ~0.92 to ~0.34 on our eval set. quick diff shows tokenizer.vocab_size != config.vocab_size after conversion.
kevin: that's suspicious — many trust_remote_code models supply a custom tokenizer class that mutates special tokens at load time. if we fallback to AutoTokenizer we can silently get offsets.
zhen: did you set `trust_remote_code=True` in the conversion step?
maria: I tried both. with trust_remote_code=True it imports a custom subclass, but our converter still writes a simplified `config.json` that drops `special_tokens_map` and `add_prefix_space` entries.
ash: can you paste the config diff and a small repro command?
maria: sure

```
# conversion command we ran
python infra/scripts/hf_to_redwood.py \
  --hf-repo org/model-with-custom-tokenizer \
  --out /tmp/redwood_model \
  --quant 4bit \
  --trust-remote-code
```

maria: config.json (HF) had:
```
{"vocab_size": 50260, "add_prefix_space": true, "special_tokens_map": {"sep_token": "<SEP>"}}
```

maria: converted config.json:
```
{"vocab_size": 50257}
```

kevin: vocab shift by 3 is classic pad/unk/special-token indexing mismatch. when embeddings are tied by index, that rewires everything.
zhen: also 4-bit quant can amplify small embedding index misalignments into large cos-sim changes.
maria: confirmed: loading HF tokenizer at runtime and using HF model weights (no conversion) keeps sims high. converted weights + converted tokenizer -> bad.

ash: short term workaround: copy the HF tokenizer files (tokenizer.json/vocab.txt/special_tokens_map.json) into our bundle and force use of that tokenizer instead of our generated one.
kevin: put another way: our hf_to_redwood script should preserve tokenizer assets and the `special_tokens_map` field. also don't re-normalize `vocab_size` unless we verified.
zhen: coding suggestion: when trust_remote_code=True, add a step to call the model repo's `tokenizer.save_pretrained(out_dir)` and keep the files verbatim. fallback: detect vocab_size mismatch and fail the conversion with a clear error.
maria: I opened a minimal repro in /tmp/emb-repro with two runs. logs:

```
# eval summary
hf-original: avg_cos_sim=0.913
converted-no-tokenizer-fix: avg_cos_sim=0.342
converted-with-tokenizer-hf-files: avg_cos_sim=0.905
```

maria: attaching the small eval set to the thread (in drive) — but core ask: should we treat trust_remote_code repos as "asset-preserve mode" by default?
ash: I think yes for tokenizers. risk: remote code could be arbitrary. but we already enable trust_remote_code when asked. if trust_remote_code=True -> preserve assets + run import in isolated process and snapshot the tokenizer outputs.
kevin: agree. also add a sanity check in the converter: compare tokenizer.vocab_size to config.vocab_size and warn/fail if mismatch > 0.
zhen: I'll sketch a patch: (1) preserve tokenizer files, (2) if `special_tokens_map` present in HF repo, copy to bundle, (3) emit a conversion log `tokenizer-preserved=true`.
maria: can you also add an eval CI job that runs a small embedding sim check post-conversion? if sims drop > 0.1 fail.
kevin: yes, we can add a lightweight unit: sample 50 pairs, compute avg cos, compare to HF loader baseline in the conversion container.

onboard-bot: Note: created issue INF-1453 "preserve tokenizer assets for trust_remote_code conversions" and assigned to @zhen.
maria: thanks. I'll add the repro and a short note in the model onboarding checklist about verifying `vocab_size` and `special_tokens_map`.
ash: TL;DR: don't strip custom tokenizer metadata during trust_remote_code conversions. preserve HF tokenizer files and add a quick embedding-sanity CI.
kevin: and add a small automated patch to compare `tokenizer.get_vocab_size()` vs `config[\"vocab_size\"]` and fail conversion if mismatched.
maria: filing a PR for the converter patch now.
